card.name: The verb miss, as in missing a dose
card.fires_on: The verb "miss" or "misses" when it means failing to take or hit something. It is strongest after "if the patient" in missed-dose instructions.

modes.label: Patient misses a dose
modes.description: "misses" follows "if a patient" or "vomits or" and comes before a dose or tablets.
modes.example: If a patient<< misses>> a single dose of memantine hydrochlor

modes.label: Other uses of miss
modes.description: "miss" in a non-medical sense, such as overlooking a page section or failing to hit a target.
modes.example: Don't<< miss>> our great houseplant growing section with self

card.writes: The promoted tokens are a loose mix and suggest no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "misses" in instructions about what to do when a dose is missed.
